1.en: When the heaven is rent asunder

2.en: and heeds gives ear to and in rending itself asunder obeys its Lord as it should that is as its duty is to heed and obey
2.ar: ﴿وأَذِنَتْ﴾ سَمِعَتْ وأَطاعَتْ فِي الِانْشِقاق ﴿لِرَبِّها وحُقَّتْ﴾ أيْ وحُقَّ لَها أنْ تَسْمَع وتُطِيع

3.en: and when the earth is stretched out when its width is increased just as a piece of leather is stretched so that no edifice or mountain remains upon it
3.ar: ﴿وإذا الأَرْض مُدَّتْ﴾ زِيدَ فِي سَعَتها كَما يُمَدّ الأَدِيم ولَمْ يَبْقَ عَلَيْها بِناء ولا جَبَل

4.en: and casts out all that is in it of the dead onto its surface and empties itself thereof
4.ar: ﴿وأَلْقَتْ ما فِيها﴾ مِن المَوْتى إلى ظاهِرها ﴿وتَخَلَّتْ﴾ عَنْهُ

5.en: and heeds and in this respect gives ear to and obeys its Lord as it should all of this will be on the Day of Resurrection the response to idhā ‘when’ and to all that is supplemented thereto has been omitted; but it is indicated by what follows it and is implied to be something like laqiya’l-insānu ‘amalahu ‘man will encounter his deeds’.
5.ar: ﴿وأَذِنَتْ﴾ سَمِعَتْ وأَطاعَتْ فِي ذَلِكَ ﴿لِرَبِّها وحُقَّتْ﴾ وذَلِكَ كُلّه يَكُون يَوْم القِيامَة، وجَواب إذا وما عُطِفَ عَلَيْها مَحْذُوف دَلَّ عَلَيْهِ ما بَعْده تَقْدِيره لَقِيَ الإنْسان عَمَله

6.en: O man! Verily you are labouring exerting your efforts toward the encounter with your Lord that is death laboriously and you will encounter it that is you will encounter your mentioned good or evil deeds on the Day of Resurrection.
6.ar: ﴿يا أيّها الإنْسان إنَّك كادِح﴾ جاهِد فِي عَمَلك ﴿إلى﴾ لِقاء ﴿رَبّك﴾ وهُوَ المَوْت ﴿كَدْحًا فَمُلاقِيه﴾ أيْ مُلاقٍ عَمَلك المَذْكُور مِن خَيْر أوْ شَرّ يَوْم القِيامَة

7.en: Then as for him who is given his book the record of his deeds in his right hand — and this is the believer —
7.ar: ﴿فَأَمّا مَن أُوتِيَ كِتابه﴾ كِتاب عَمَله ﴿بِيَمِينِهِ﴾ هُوَ المُؤْمِن

8.en: he will receive an easy reckoning which simply entails the presentation of his deeds to him as in the hadīth of the two Sahīhs of Bukhārī and Muslim — in which there is also a hadīth saying ‘He who is reckoned with at length will be destined for perdition’ — and after this presentation of his deeds to the believer he will be excused
8.ar: ﴿فَسَوْفَ يُحاسَب حِسابًا يَسِيرًا﴾ هُوَ عَرْض عَمَله عَلَيْهِ كَما فِي حَدِيث الصَّحِيحَيْنِ وفِيهِ " مَن نُوقِشَ الحِساب هَلَكَ " وبَعْد العَرْض يُتَجاوَز عَنْهُ

9.en: and return to his family in Paradise joyful because of it.

10.en: But as for him who is given his book from behind his back — and this is the disbeliever whose right hand is chained to his neck and whose left hand by which he is given the book is placed behind his back
10.ar: ﴿وأَمّا مَن أُوتِيَ كِتابه وراء ظَهْره﴾ هُوَ الكافِر تُغَلّ يُمْناهُ إلى عُنُقه وتُجْعَل يُسْراهُ وراء ظَهْره فَيَأْخُذ بِها كِتابه

11.en: he will pray upon seeing what is in it for annihilation he will invoke destruction against himself by saying yā thabūrāh ‘O annihilation of mine!’
11.ar: ﴿فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُو﴾ عِنْد رُؤْيَته ما فِيهِ ﴿ثُبُورًا﴾ يُنادِي هَلاكه بِقَوْلِهِ: يا ثُبُوراه

12.en: and he will enter the Blaze an intense fire a variant reading for yaslā ‘he will enter’ has yusallā ‘he will be admitted’.
12.ar: ﴿ويَصْلى سَعِيرًا﴾ يَدْخُل النّار الشَّدِيدَة وفِي قِراءَة بِضَمِّ الياء وفَتْح الصّاد واللّام المُشَدَّدَة

13.en: Indeed among his folk his clan in the world he used to be joyful wanton lusting after his desires;
13.ar: " ﴿إنَّهُ كانَ فِي أهْله﴾ عَشِيرَته فِي الدُّنْيا ﴿مَسْرُورًا﴾ بَطِرًا بِاتِّباعِهِ لِهَواهُ

14.en: indeed he thought that an softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted that is to say annahu he would never return to his Lord.
14.ar: ﴿إنَّهُ ظَنَّ أنْ﴾ مُخَفَّفَة مِن الثَّقِيلَة واسْمها مَحْذُوف، أيْ أنَّهُ ﴿لَنْ يَحُور﴾ يَرْجِع إلى رَبّه

15.en: Nay! he will return to Him; indeed his Lord is ever Seer of him knowing that he would return to Him.
15.ar: ﴿بَلى﴾ يَرْجِع إلَيْهِ ﴿إنَّ رَبّه كانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا﴾ عالِمًا بِرُجُوعِهِ إلَيْهِ

16.en: So I swear fa-lā lā is extra by the twilight al-shafaq the reddishness visible in the horizon after the sunset
16.ar: ﴿فَلا أُقْسِم﴾ لا زائِدَة ﴿بِالشَّفَقِ﴾ هُوَ الحُمْرَة فِي الأُفُق بَعْد غُرُوب الشَّمْس

17.en: and by the night and what it envelops what it brings together of creatures and otherwise that have entered into it
17.ar: ﴿واللَّيْل وما وسَقَ﴾ جَمَعَ ما دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ مِن الدَّوابّ وغَيْرها

18.en: and by the moon when it is at the full and its light is complete and this happens during the nights of the full moon
18.ar: ﴿والقَمَر إذا اِتَّسَقَ﴾ اِجْتَمَعَ وتَمَّ نُوره وذَلِكَ فِي اللَّيالِي البِيض

19.en: you will surely journey tarkabunna is actually tarkabūnanna but the nūn of the indicative has been omitted because of two identical letters following one another and the wāw is omitted because of two unvocalised consonants coming together from stage to stage state after state namely death then life then what comes afterwards of the states at the Resurrection.
19.ar: ﴿لَتَرْكَبُنَّ﴾ أيّها النّاس أصْله تَرْكَبُونَنَّ حُذِفَتْ نُون الرَّفْع لِتَوالِي الأَمْثال والواو لِالتِقاءِ السّاكِنَيْنِ ﴿طَبَقًا عَنْ طَبَق﴾ حالًا بَعْد حال، وهُوَ المَوْت ثُمَّ الحَياة وما بَعْدها مِن أحْوال القِيامَة

20.en: So what is wrong with them that is the disbelievers that they do not have faith that is to say what is there to prevent them from embracing faith; or what argument do they have for neglecting it despite the existence of proofs for it
20.ar: ﴿فَما لَهُمْ﴾ أيْ الكُفّار ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ أيْ أيّ مانِع مِن الإيمان أوْ أيّ حُجَّة لَهُمْ فِي تَرْكه مَعَ وُجُود بَراهِينه

21.en: and what is wrong with them that when the Qur’ān is recited to them they do not prostrate? they do not submit by believing in it given its inimitability?
21.ar: ﴿و﴾ ما لَهُمْ ﴿إذا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمْ القُرْآن لا يَسْجُدُونَ﴾ يَخْضَعُونَ بِأَنْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ لِإعْجازِهِ

22.en: Nay but the disbelievers deny resurrection and other matters

23.en: and God knows best what they are amassing accumulating in their scrolls in the way of disbelief denial and evil deeds.
23.ar: ﴿واللَّه أعْلَم بِما يُوعُونَ﴾ يَجْمَعُونَ فِي صُحُفهمْ مِن الكُفْر والتَّكْذِيب وأَعْمال السُّوء

24.en: So give them good tidings inform them of a painful chastisement

25.en: except those who believe and perform righteous deeds theirs will be an unfailing reward one that is unending undiminished and not given to them in expectance of anything in return.
25.ar: ﴿إلّا﴾ لَكِنْ ﴿الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وعَمِلُوا الصّالِحات لَهُ أجْر غَيْر مَمْنُون﴾ غَيْر مَقْطُوع ولا مَنقُوص ولا يُمَنّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ.
